name: GSG on cal short: bad SIG contact (2 Ω)

example.note: The same short with 2 Ω at the signal tip. The TDR now settles at 2 Ω, almost two decades above a good landing, and |S11| drops to about −0.7 dB. Two resistive ground tips would look the same: a one-port sees one current loop and can’t tell where in it the resistance sits. Set R to 1 MΩ for a tip that never landed.
example.author: TDR Painter
